Workers of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] constructed a '''base''' between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]]. It was one of the early settlements built on the moon during the Wookiees' [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization effort]] there. The base comprised a single [[command center]], several [[prefab shelter]]s, a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]], an [[animal nursery]], and a [[Power core/Legends|power core]]. At the base, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] aided the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] in training [[Bowcaster trooper|warriors]] to attack a nearby [[Unidentified gundark nest|nest]] of predatory [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]].

==Description==
[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] laborers built multiple bases on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]]. One such base initially contained only a single building, the [[command center]], but was later expanded to include several [[prefab shelter]]s to house more Wookiees, a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]] for training warriors,<ref name="SW:GB" /> an [[animal nursery]],<ref name="SW:GBP" /> and a [[Power core/Legends|power core]] for supplying energy to the buildings in the settlement. The base was constructed in close proximity to a large [[Tree/Legends|forest]] and near several [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] [[Bush/Legends|bushes]], and it was also a short distance south of a [[Unidentified gundark nest|nest]] of [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] predatory [[Species/Legends|species]] on Alaris Prime.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==History==
The Wookiees constructed the base during their [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization]] effort on Alaris Prime<ref name="SW:GB" /> between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> The base was initially only home to three Wookiee workers and one of the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists']] leaders, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Another worker soon arrived at the base, and, acting on advice from [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who was supervising the colonization on behalf of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], the Wookiees began gathering [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] from the nearby [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] bushes and [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] from the trees. The workers then built prefab shelters to allow more Wookiees to come to the base,<ref name="SW:GB" /> and Jinn afterward instructed Chewbacca on how to catch [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] and herd them into the Wookiees' animal nursery in order to produce more food.<ref name="SW:GBP" />

More workers began to assist at the base until ten of them were gathering resources.<ref name="SW:GBP" /> Jinn then had the workers construct a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] center in order to train warriors to [[Death/Legends|eliminate]] the gundarks at their nest, as the creatures had [[Attack on Attichitcuk's camp|been]] [[Attack on the Wookiee command center|attacking]] the Wookiees upon their arrival on Alaris Prime.<ref name="SW:GB" /> At least ten [[Bowcaster trooper|warriors]]<ref name="SW:GBP" /> were trained to wield [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]], a Wookiee projectile weapon, at the troop center, and the workers simultaneously built a power core to give more energy to the buildings in the base. With the troops prepared, Chewbacca led an [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|attack]] on the gundark nest, where the Wookiees also encountered [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] corporation that was illegally trying to colonize Alaris Prime.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Click on your command center, now click on the create worker button.|Qui-Gon Jinn instructing the player|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
The Wookiee base was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="SW:GBP">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="SW:GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The base appears in the third level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "Building an Army," in which the base originally starts off with just a command center and the player is instructed to build the prefab shelters, a troop center, and a power core throughout the level.<ref name="SW:GB" /> The strategy guide instructs the player to train ten workers and ten troopers, which this article uses to determine the [[canon]]ical number of Wookiees at the base. The guide also instructs the player to construct an animal nursery, which is optional in the game.<ref name="SW:GBP" />
